name: Auriferous-Serac
description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws tectonic rift valleys, patient as erosion itself.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.

The terrain around escape pod debris field is scarred for kilometers, and the wreck's black box still loops two seconds of static on an obsolete band. Insurance investigators consider it a haunted assignment.
Wreck-divers talk about the site in lowered voices, and salvage guilds post hazard bonuses that only grow.
